hypothesis.statement: The scratch pair is allocated from the BOTTOM of the volatile range and the declared group from the TOP, so the target's interleaved layout cannot be produced by any pure declaration-list edit; it needs the accumulators SPLIT into two groups by an intervening construct. Read from the streams: the target's scratch pair is `@0x320 lwz r6,23216(r24)` and `@0x324 add r7,r24,r5`, sitting BETWEEN its accumulator zero inits `@0x30c li r3,0` (fmtShift) / `@0x304 li r4,0` (spShift) below it and `@0x308 li r8,0` (ciCount) / `@0x300 li r10,0` (iconCount) above it; ours after this probe puts the same scratch pair at `@0x320 lwz r3,23216(r24)` and `@0x324 add r4,r24,r8`, i.e. beneath the whole group. The untried lever is therefore a nested BLOCK: declare fmtShift and spShift in an inner scope that closes before ciCount and iconCount are declared, so MWCC sees two separate declaration groups rather than one contiguous run.
